verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly show creating PRs from the app (via Copilot: 'open a new pull request', 'assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request... approve and merge'), directly supporting PR creation on the go. However, independent community reports flag real UX friction in review/diff handling (wrapped diffs, broken per-commit review, missing activity feed) that could affect the PR workflow, and there's no first-party or community confirmation of manually creating a PR without Copilot. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of manual (non-Copilot) PR creation, and evidence the review/merge flow works smoothly end-to-end.
